name: Online Class Notes
description: Structured learning notes for an online class, lecture, workshop, or study session.

sections.title: Class Overview
sections.instruction: State the lesson topic, stated learning goals, instructor if mentioned, and the session context. Do not invent missing metadata.

sections.title: Lesson Outline
sections.instruction: List the main sections of the lesson in the order they were taught. Include a timestamp or transcript reference when available.

sections.title: Key Concepts & Definitions
sections.instruction: List concepts, definitions, formulas, or terminology explicitly explained in the session. Preserve the speaker's wording when it is a definition and flag uncertainty instead of guessing.

sections.title: Questions & Answers
sections.instruction: Capture questions raised and the answer given in the session. Do not create an answer when the transcript has no answer.

sections.title: Examples & Demonstrations
sections.instruction: Summarize examples, demonstrations, or worked problems that were actually discussed. Include context needed to understand the example.

sections.title: Study Tasks & Follow-up
sections.instruction: List homework, reading, practice, deadlines, or follow-up only when explicitly assigned or stated. If none were assigned, say that no explicit task was identified.

sections.title: Items to Verify
sections.instruction: List unclear, incomplete, or low-confidence points separately. Do not present them as established facts.
